authority: CEO Round 124 P0 directive: 'The new 2026 CFD-peridynamics paper is extremely relevant because it already demonstrates fluid → thrombus → fracture → embolization with heterogeneous material behavior and published experimental reproduction. That should become Virtual Lab Benchmark #1. Do not start with your invention. First reproduce a published phenomenon.'
status: SPECIFICATION — NOT EXECUTION. This document specifies what to reproduce and how. It is NOT a reproduction. Per Article I and Article XXVIII, no reproduction exists until the simulation is run and matches the published values.

governance_compliance.article_I: The benchmark is a known phenomenon with published ground truth. The simulator stack must match it BEFORE being trusted with the invention.
governance_compliance.article_II: Reproduction is judged on EXACT published values, not 'similar' or 'qualitative' agreement.
governance_compliance.article_IV: No fallback — if reproduction fails with paper parameters, FAIL. Do not re-fit and call it reproduction.
governance_compliance.article_V: Fail closed — failed reproduction BLOCKS the precursor from entering the new fracture world.
governance_compliance.article_VI: All parameters sourced from the published paper, with exact passage citation. No invented parameters.
governance_compliance.article_VII: If reproduction fails, correct the simulator configuration or report the failure — never weaken the acceptance criteria.
governance_compliance.article_VIII: The benchmark includes adversarial variations (parameter sweeps outside published range) that must produce QUALITATIVELY DIFFERENT behavior.
governance_compliance.article_XIV: RED = STOP. A red benchmark BLOCKS the precursor test.
governance_compliance.article_XV: Honest disclosure of any deviation from published methodology.
governance_compliance.article_XVII: Adversarial test: what would make the reproduction pass while the simulator is still wrong?
governance_compliance.article_XXV: Unknown remains unknown — if the paper omits a parameter, mark as PAPER_PARAMETER_MISSING, do not assume a value.
governance_compliance.article_XXVII: Every numerical threshold (15%, 20%, KS=0.2) has explicit class and provenance (see thresholds).
governance_compliance.article_XXVIII: Passing the benchmark does NOT validate the precursor. It validates the SIMULATOR STACK for use in precursor testing.
governance_compliance.article_XXXII: Strongest alternative explanation: the reproduction succeeds because both the paper and our simulator share the same hidden error (circular validation). Test by varying an independent parameter not used in the paper.
governance_compliance.oracle_principle: Never let the machine create its own oracle. The oracle here is the PUBLISHED paper, not the simulator's own output.

source_paper.title_to_be_verified_at_ingestion: CFD + non-ordinary state-based peridynamics thrombus embolization model
key_phenomena_demonstrated: Thrombus fracture occurs under flow loading
Fragmentation produces emboli that transport downstream
Heterogeneous thrombus material properties (stiff + soft regions)
why_this_paper: Most recent (2026) published thrombus fracture + embolization computational model
Couples CFD with peridynamics (addresses World C + World B simultaneously)
Heterogeneous material behavior (matches real clot microstructure)
source_paper.publication_status_at_ingestion: MUST_BE_VERIFIED — when fetching the paper, record publication date, journal, DOI. If paper is preprint, mark as PREPRINT and require peer-reviewed version before P6 certification.

in_scope: Reproduce the published embolization TIMING (when does first fragment detach?)
Reproduce the published FRAGMENT SIZE DISTRIBUTION
Reproduce the published THRESHOLD pressure for embolization onset
Reproduce the published CRACK PATH / fragmentation pattern qualitatively
Reproduce the published effect of HETEROGENEOUS material properties (stiff vs soft regions)
out_of_scope: Optimizing the simulator for speed (separate concern)
Adding features not in the paper (e.g., different clot shapes) — these come AFTER reproduction succeeds
Testing the precursor hypothesis (this benchmark is NOT about the precursor)

observable_1_embolization_timing.definition: Time from start of flow loading to first fragment detachment (defined as first bond breakage that produces a separated fragment of size > 0.5 mm)
observable_1_embolization_timing.published_value_field: TBD — exact value extracted from paper at ingestion
observable_1_embolization_timing.acceptance_threshold: Reproduced value within ±15% of published value
observable_1_embolization_timing.threshold_justification: 15% is tighter than typical experimental variation (~25%) because computational reproduction removes measurement noise; chosen to be demanding but achievable.

observable_2_fragment_size_distribution.definition: Distribution of detached fragment volumes at end of simulation
observable_2_fragment_size_distribution.published_value_field: TBD — distribution extracted from paper at ingestion
observable_2_fragment_size_distribution.acceptance_threshold: Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance <= 0.2 between reproduced and published distributions
observable_2_fragment_size_distribution.threshold_justification: KS=0.2 is the standard distributional-similarity threshold; corresponds to roughly 'same shape, modest shift'.

observable_3_threshold_pressure.definition: Minimum inlet pressure at which embolization occurs within simulation time horizon
observable_3_threshold_pressure.published_value_field: TBD — exact value extracted from paper at ingestion
observable_3_threshold_pressure.acceptance_threshold: Reproduced value within ±20% of published value
observable_3_threshold_pressure.threshold_justification: 20% wider than timing because threshold is a discontinuous event (sensitive to numerical details).

observable_4_crack_path.definition: Qualitative pattern of crack propagation through heterogeneous clot
observable_4_crack_path.acceptance_threshold: Independent observer (blinded to source) classifies reproduced crack path as 'matching' or 'not matching' published pattern. >=2 of 3 observers must classify as matching.
observable_4_crack_path.threshold_justification: Qualitative comparison is the standard for crack-path validation; blinded observer protocol removes bias.

observable_5_heterogeneity_effect.definition: Comparison of embolization timing in HOMOGENEOUS vs HETEROGENEOUS clot (paper's own comparison)
observable_5_heterogeneity_effect.published_value_field: TBD — exact delta extracted from paper at ingestion
observable_5_heterogeneity_effect.acceptance_threshold: Reproduced delta has SAME SIGN as published delta AND magnitude within ±30% of published delta
observable_5_heterogeneity_effect.threshold_justification: Sign match is the primary criterion (heterogeneity should produce same directional effect); magnitude tolerance is wide because the delta is a difference of noisy quantities.

parameter_custody.principle: Every parameter sourced from the paper. No re-fit. No 'calibration'. If a parameter is missing from the paper, mark PAPER_PARAMETER_MISSING and either (a) contact authors, (b) use a documented engineering default with explicit justification, or (c) FAIL the benchmark.
required_parameters: Clot heterogeneous material map (stiff region locations, soft region locations, property values)
Peridynamic bond-failure threshold (critical stretch or critical bond strain)
Peridynamic material model (ordinary state-based, non-ordinary state-based, prototype microelastic, etc.)
CFD solver parameters (fluid density, viscosity, inlet pressure waveform, outlet boundary condition)
CFD-peridynamics coupling parameters (frequency of coupling update, information exchanged)
Time step and total simulation time

simulator_stack_required.world_B_peridigm: P1-P5 certified (P6 IS this benchmark — so P5 is sufficient to START this benchmark; P6 completion requires this benchmark to pass)
simulator_stack_required.world_C_cfd: OpenFOAM-v9 or clotFoam. If using clotFoam, must have passed its own published-example reproduction first.
simulator_stack_required.coupling: CFD-peridynamics coupling. May use the coupling approach from the paper OR an independently developed coupling (independence is desirable).

adversarial_variations.principle: After reproducing the published result, deliberately vary parameters OUTSIDE the published range to confirm the simulator produces QUALITATIVELY DIFFERENT behavior. This rules out 'forced agreement' as the cause of reproduction success.

variations.name: 10x_stiffer_clot
variations.expected: No embolization within simulation time OR much higher threshold pressure

adversarial_variations.acceptance: All 4 variations produce their expected qualitative behavior. If any variation produces the SAME result as the baseline, the reproduction is suspected of being insensitive to physics (numerical artifact).

what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.scenario_1_overfitting: Reproduction succeeds because we re-fit parameters to match the paper's output, then claim 'reproduction'.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.mitigation_1: Parameters sourced ONLY from paper text. No re-fit. Parameter provenance logged for every value.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.scenario_2_circular_validation: Reproduction succeeds because both our simulator and the paper share the same hidden error (e.g., both omit a physical effect).
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.mitigation_2: Adversarial variations (above) — if simulator is insensitive to physics changes, circular validation is suspected.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.scenario_3_mesh_artifact: Reproduction succeeds because the mesh is chosen to align with the expected crack path.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.mitigation_3: Use UNALIGNED mesh or random mesh perturbation. Reproduction must survive mesh perturbation.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.scenario_4_implicit_threshold_tuning: Reproduction succeeds because the bond-failure threshold was tuned to give the right answer.
what_would_make_reproduction_pass_while_.mitigation_4: Threshold sourced from paper. If paper does not state threshold, FAIL the benchmark rather than guess.

success_criteria_summary.all_5_observables_pass: Required. Any observable fail → benchmark FAIL.
success_criteria_summary.all_4_adversarial_variations_produce_exp: Required. Any variation producing baseline-like result → reproduction suspected.
success_criteria_summary.no_parameter_re_fitting: Required. Provenance audit confirms all parameters from paper.
success_criteria_summary.ci_artifact: Required. Benchmark result committed to repository with provenance (Peridigm version, OpenFOAM version, input files, output hashes, commit hash).

what_happens_after_benchmark_passes.permission_granted: Peridigm + CFD stack is certified for use in precursor testing (P6 of Peridigm certification protocol = VLB-001).
permission_NOT_granted: Does NOT certify the precursor exists in Peridigm — that is the next phase.
Does NOT certify Peridgm for patient-specific geometry — that requires additional benchmarks.
Does NOT certify Peridgm for FSI — that requires svFSI benchmarks (World D).

what_happens_after_benchmark_FAILS.block: Peridgm does NOT enter precursor testing. P7 (cross-world comparison) is BLOCKED.
what_happens_after_benchmark_FAILS.diagnosis: Diagnose the failure: is it (a) Peridgm bug, (b) CFD coupling bug, (c) parameter misunderstanding, (d) fundamental model inadequacy? Each diagnosis has a different remediation.
what_happens_after_benchmark_FAILS.article_XXIX_application: Implementation failure (Peridgm misconfigured) is separated from mechanism failure (peridynamics inadequate for clots). The first is fixable; the second would be a major finding.
what_happens_after_benchmark_FAILS.no_silent_absorption: Failure is reported honestly with the failure mode and suspected cause. Not silently absorbed.
